pre_capture_js: const firstCard = document.querySelector("otto-web-logical-driver-task-event-card");if (firstCard) {const leftCol = firstCard.querySelector(".general-info__left");const locInfo = firstCard.querySelector(".location-info");if (leftCol && locInfo) {const r1 = leftCol.getBoundingClientRect();const r2 = locInfo.getBoundingClientRect();const top = r1.top - 4;const left = r1.left - 8;const right = r1.right + 8;const bottom = r2.bottom + 4;const ov = document.createElement("div");ov.style.cssText = "position:fixed;pointer-events:none;z-index:9999;box-sizing:border-box;border:3px solid rgb(0,98,132);border-radius:4px;";ov.style.left = left + "px";ov.style.top = top + "px";ov.style.width = (right - left) + "px";ov.style.height = (bottom - top) + "px";document.body.appendChild(ov);}}
